spans.s: धिषण (I) m. An epithet of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods.
धिषण (II) n. A dwelling-place, an abode.
धिषणा f. 1. Speech; 2. praise, hymn; 3. intellect; 4. the earth.
धिष्ण्य (I) m. 1. A place for the sacrificial fire, अमी वेदिं परितः कॢप्तधिष्ण्याः Sak.i.; 2. an epithet of Śukra, the preceptor of the demons; 3. the planet Venus; 4. power, strength.
धिष्ण्य (II) n. 1. A seat, an abode, a house, न भौमान्येव धिष्ण्यानि हित्वा ज्योतिर्मयान्यपि R.xv.59; 2. a meteor, a star; 3. fire.
धी-मंत्रिन्, -सचिव m. a minister for counsel, (op. to कर्ममंत्रिन् ‘a member of the executive’).
धी-सख m. an adviser, a minister.
